evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing without establishing concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep gave a price range ($666–$1,110) with no mention of day-of-week pricing flexibility or Value Days.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep asked 'Does that feel fair?' but never asked for the business explicitly. No rate lock mentioned. Move was already booked online; rep confirmed existing booking instead of closing a new one.

top_strength: Danah systematically gathered detailed logistics (property type, bedroom count, garage status, special items, appliances, box count, destination details, floor/elevator) with clear, methodical probing.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire Two Concerns step—no opening question, no promises, no permission lead-in—and jumped straight to verifying a pre-booked move; add the Two Concerns and Two Promises steps even when a customer has already booked online, and close with an explicit ask like 'Would you like our help with your move?' rather than 'Does that feel fair?'
